title: TPMS lattice ML: data and code for machine-learning-enabled structure-property mapping of TPMS lattice structures
description: Finite-element dataset of 270 triply periodic minimal surface (TPMS) lattices (Diamond, Gyroid, Lidinoid, Schwarz, SplitP), machine-learning surrogate models for Young's modulus and specific stiffness, inverse design, SHAP analysis, Bayesian optimization scripts, and a browser calculator.
